title: Compare and hash paths only through src/paths.js
trigger: when comparing, hashing or relativizing a filesystem path that another process may spell differently (project root, data directory name, build id, repo_root in the bridge, file scopes)
behavior_delta: Use samePath/normalizePath for comparisons and hashes and projectRelative for scope paths, all from src/paths.js; never compare resolve() strings. normalizePath resolves symlinks (through the nearest existing parent) and folds case on win32 and darwin; it is a key, not a path to open, so read or walk files by physicalPath.
what: Use samePath/normalizePath for comparisons and hashes and projectRelative for scope paths, all from src/paths.js; never compare resolve() strings. normalizePath resolves symlinks (through the nearest existing parent) and folds case on win32 and darwin; it is a key, not a path to open, so read or walk files by physicalPath.
why: Processes spell one project differently: the MCP server uses process.cwd() (physical), hooks pass the harness cwd (possibly a symlink such as macOS /tmp -> /private/tmp), and Windows and default macOS volumes ignore case. Unnormalized comparisons split data directories, made the bridge reject the resident and broke file scopes; covered by tests/hooks/paths.test.js with real symlinks.
